item.title: Kurage Life
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: Tail Aki
  • 発売日: 2024-02-25
  • スコア: 6.529999999999999/10 (37 人評価)
  • 日本語名: くらげらいふ
  • 英語名: Kurage Life

别名

  • Jellyfishs Life

あらすじ

In Kurage Life, you’ll play as a guy who takes over his dead father’s ramen shop called “Kurage-tei” in order to pay off his debts.

In the shop, you meet the plain heroine Mitsuki Ayakawa who is working there part-time.

However, she’s a shut-in and super-introverted. It won’t make paying off your debts easy, that’s for sure…

  • 英語名: Yuganda Yokubou - Netorase Tsuma Shelly

别名

  • Yuganda Yokubou - Netorase Tsuma Shelly

あらすじ

Eddy was the proprietor of a run-down tavern living a boring life. That was until he met an adventurer named Shelly. One thing led to another, and the two tied the knot.

She was a total beauty, with great proportions to boot. Surely, Eddy was the happiest man in the world…
